notes.title: Yay HRDINA DLC is out !
notes.content:
Hi all,

we are happy to announce that the DLC in form of OST (14 tracks : 57min of music) in MP3 and FLAC format was released.

The physical version of the album also contains a booklet, which is also included within the DLC in digital form.

Enjoy the great music of Zrni.

notes.title: OST DLC Is about to happen
notes.content:
Hello game and music lovers.

We had hammered everything out and the OST DLC will be availble in few days.

Included will be : 
* Full album "Hrdina počítačový hry jde do světa" 
* 14 songs in MP3 320kbps format 
* Also in FLAC format !!!
* 112 images from the physical booklet that is included with physical media.

Watch our facebook feed and be among the first to get the release notification. [url=https://www.facebook.com/bartos.studio/]Bartoš Studio FB[/url]

notes.title: HRDINA OST DLC ?
notes.content:
Thumb up if you are interested in DLC in a form of downloadable MP3/FLAC files in the best available quality.
The music will be yours to listen when ever you want on any device (supporting MP3/FLAC).
There are some legal things to work out, however the DLC is considered to be released in next few weeks and most likely it won't be for free, but the price will be very reasonable.

Let us know in the comments if you are interested in such DLC.

We might pack in few surprises in the DLC if all goes well.

notes.title: Patch 1.1906.43 is out
notes.content:
Hi all,

the game was patched addressing the most pressing issues.
There were not many which is great.
[FIXED STUFF]
(1) - Key info is now shown for longer time and it will fade after jump
(2) - Added info about ability of double jump in to the key info
(3) - Added command line option to start the game in safe resolution "saferes"
(4) - Unlocking of music Loading and 83000 now shown correctly (Loading will unlock in Credits)
(5) - Some minor UI animation tweaks

[TO DO STUFF]
- In future patch there will be also ability to reconfigure keys.
- issue with loud music on some headphones
- double monitor stretching (under investigation)

1.1906.47
- minor patch was released, the crate contents have now unified animations

That is all for now.
Enjoy the game !
